messages:
incident-bot: P1 alert — elevated 5xx rate and tail latency on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Trigger: error-rate > 5% for 3m. Suggested owner: oncall-sre-maria. Runbook: inference-service > high-5xx. Alert: https://alerts.internal/r/1793456781 :rotating_light:

maria: acked. I'm taking ownership. spinning up warroom and suspending non-critical deploys. joining in 30s.

jonah: ping — is this specific to a model or all traffic? I see model-llama2-usw2 hitting CPU throttling on the autoscaler dashboard.

samir: looking at infra. autoscaler hit max replicas around 12:30. can we increase cap to 30 temporarily? If memory, some nodes are running mixed quantized and fp16 variants causing OOMs.

maria: @samir go for it. ops-bot, please run vertical scale to cap=30 for cluster-inference-usw2.

ops-bot: Executing: `kubectl scale --replicas=30 deployment/inference-pool-usw2` — started. ETA ~90s.

claire: drafting status page / customer note. Proposal below — please edit.
```
Status: Degraded performance for text-generation in US-West (us-west-2).
Impact: A subset of requests to the /v1/generate endpoint may see increased error rates or slower responses.
Mitigation: Teams are scaling capacity and enabling fallback model variants. We expect partial recovery within 30 minutes.
Updates: We will provide further updates every 15 minutes.
```

kevin: +1 on that wording. Add "no customer data exposed" line.

claire: updated draft with the security note. new copy: 
"No customer data has been exposed or deleted. We are prioritizing reliability and will notify if impact changes."

jonah: I pushed a quick routing change to divert 25% of traffic to model-quantized-usw2 as a temporary fallback: `routingctl set-weight /v1/generate model-quantized-usw2 0.25`. Monitor latency increase on that path.

samir: scale completed — pods coming up, some warming errors in the logs pointing to KV cache pressure. Running `redis-clusterctl reshard` and increasing maxmemory-policy.

maria: warroom link: https://meet.internal/warroom/1793456781 (passcode in 1:1). Owner: maria (oncall-sre). Primary mitigation: scale + fallback routing. Secondary: drain bad nodes and rollback recent kernel patch (if needed).

claire: posting to status page now. copying customer notification to /comm-drafts/incidents/1793456781-draft.md and pinging comms for review.

jonah: quick sanity check — injecting a small load test against quantized fallback shows 95th latency ~1200ms vs 95th ~350ms normal; that’s acceptable short-term to reduce errors.

kevin: I notified sales and a handful of high-touch customers via email template (internal draft).

maria: team — please add short logs and checks to this thread as you find them. next update in 10m or when we hit recovery. :thumbsup:

samir: log sample (filtered):
```
E 12:31:04 inference: OOM when allocating KV cache for shard-12
W 12:31:15 autoscaler: reached replica cap, rejecting additional scale requests
I 12:31:20 routing: 502 upstream read timeout from model-llama2-usw2-3
```

jonah: remediation steps applied: routing change, `kv-cache-compact` triggered, quantized variant warmed. errors down from 5.6% -> 1.4% in last 3m window.

maria: confirming pager handoff: I'm primary owner until 1800 UTC then handing to oncall-sre-kevin for monitoring-only. if we get regression >3% errs we'll reopen pager and escalate.

claire: status page update posted (ID: SP-1793456781). customer comms sent to affected bucket.

kevin: acknowledged handoff. monitoring dashboards + alert tweaks copied to my runbook.

maria: closing initial kickoff. continuing mitigation in warroom. thanks all. :heart:
